brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3x hex-acc-keyhole on rear faces: accessory:0#0,0#3 at 0,0,0 slot3, accessory:0#1,-1#3 at 1,-1,0 slot3, accessory:0#1,0#4 at 1,0,0 slot4 — all on same outward side for wall mounting
4x hex-acc-hook plates (each with two hooks) on front faces: accessory:0#0,0#2, accessory:0#1,-1#0, accessory:0#1,0#0, accessory:0#1,0#1 — providing 8 hook positions across 3-cell horizontal rack

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell horizontal tool rack (pieces at 0,0,0 / 1,-1,0 / 1,0,0) joined with joint bolts. Rear side has 3 keyhole hangers for wall mounting, front side has 4 hook plates (8 hooks) for hand tools. Mesh clash clear and structurally joined.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
